product_metadata.title: NFL Tailgater Salt & Pepper Shakers
features: Made in the USA and Imported
Lids feature a P and S design
Matching glass salt & pepper shakers that are 3.75 inches tall
The bright team graphics will make you the envy of any new England Patriots fan
description: No tailgate party is complete without these salt and pepper shakers featuring bright team graphics. They are 3.75 inches tall and the screw top lids have holes that spell out P and S. These team shakers are a great grill accessory. Made by Siskiyou Gifts.
